description: This Java class defines a BroadcastReceiver named WiFiDirectBroadcastReceiver that listens for Wi-Fi P2P (Wi-Fi Direct) related system broadcasts such as connection changes and device status updates. Its primary role is to handle Wi-Fi Direct connection events, request connection info, and log device status, facilitating Wi-Fi Direct peer discovery and connection management within an Android application.

classes.name: WiFiDirectBroadcastReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for Wi-Fi Direct related system broadcast events, such as connection changes and device info updates, to manage Wi-Fi P2P connections within the app.

methods.name: WiFiDirectBroadcastReceiver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the BroadcastReceiver with Wi-Fi P2P manager, channel, and associated activity.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles received broadcasts related to Wi-Fi P2P events, checks for connection status changes, requests connection info, and logs device status updates.
